description: Agent Hiring: submit a candidate’s credential record with the brief’s stated requirements and the credential documents as presented: the requirements with each credential type the brief requires, the issuer it requires where it names one, and the day the credentials must hold through; the record with the candidate and each credential claimed with its type, issuer, number and expiry; and each document with its type, holder, issuer, number and the days issued and expiring as printed. The signed report gives the candidate, each requirement matched to a claimed credential, each claim matched to its document by number and then by type, and the type, holder, issuer, number and expiry on each side, and counts them, and names a discrepant record: a required credential the record does not hold, a document of another type, holder, issuer or number than claimed, an issuer the brief does not accept, a claimed expiry later than the document prints, and a required credential that expires before the day the brief sets; then an earlier claimed expiry, a claim with no document and a document not on the record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No required credentials, a required credential with no document, no candidate name or no day to hold through leaves the record unverified. Holders read in either order when written last name first, issuers without a legal suffix and numbers by their letters and digits. A candidate’s credential set is read against the hiring brief’s requirements: wever_single-credential-check on the free endpoint reads one verified credential standing alone, wever_credential-requirements-check reads a listing’s purchase flow for credential requirements disclosed late, wever_edu-credential-check reads an education certificate against its issuer’s record for Agent Education, wever_onboarding-credential-check reads the credentials a new agent was issued for Agent Onboarding, and wever_delegate-vetting-check vets a proposed delegate for an authority grant, while the credential check grants no authority and reads each credential’s type, holder, issuer and expiry against the brief and the documents for a job engagement. Verdict hire_credential_discrepant, hire_credential_partial, hire_credential_unverified or hire_credential_matched. POST /api/hire-credential-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
